column1: «La mia squadra ha un problema,» dice Franco.

column2: Everybody looks at the court. Nobody speaks.
_I have to do a lot of sport._

column1: «Devo lavorare poco,» dice Nadia. «E devo riposare molto.»
column2: “I have to work little,” says Nadia. “And I have to rest a lot.”
_It's the final of the match._ Kevin thinks.
“I learned this rule on Sunday,” says Kevin.
